title: Kuzushi Module Manifest
description: Published compatibility metadata for a Kuzushi package/file module. Local KWP execution authority is granted separately through kuzushi.lock.

id.description: Unique kebab-case module id. Tool names must start with `<id>:`.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in the shell's module catalog.

version.description: Semver of this module, independent of the optional host-compatibility field.

entry.description: Entry module path, relative to the manifest.

kuzushiSdkVersion.description: Deprecated compatibility metadata naming the expected Kuzushi host version. Local KWP workers negotiate the protocol and exact host package version at startup instead.

env.description: Compatibility metadata only; it does not grant a local KWP worker access to environment variables.

bins.description: Compatibility metadata only; it does not grant a local KWP worker process execution.

nodeVersion.description: Compatibility metadata for a package host (for example, '>=22').

configSchema.description: Compatibility metadata for per-module configuration; it does not grant local KWP capabilities.
